description: Recompute overdraft and NSF fee events in two stages: an independent replay of the posted ledger under the caller's declared posting-order policy and fee schedule, diffed by post date and fee type against caller-supplied core-charged fees with a MATCHES, DIVERGES, or INDETERMINATE verdict (ART-662), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Posting order and every fee-schedule term are caller-declared inputs; a divergence is an arithmetic finding, never a determination that a fee was charged incorrectly. Not legal advice.
name: overdraft-nsf-fee-recompute-check

steps.handoff: Replays the posted ledger under the declared posting-order policy and fee schedule to recompute each OD and NSF fee event; recomputed totals are diffed by post date and fee type against the caller-supplied core-charged figures, with verdict MATCHES, DIVERGES, or INDETERMINATE
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Overdraft / NSF Fee Recompute Check
